text:
They gave you life and now you live

even beyond their desires.

You were for them a necessary chimera

and you take possession of your owners.


And we will not say you do not exist

though tenaciously we deny you:

if in the desert of their life

your dreamed kingdoms are only mirages,

in our mind you are, you are, perhaps

more than we are, you are certain.

translation.title: They Gave You Life
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the paradox of an invented being becoming more certain than its makers.
